name: Hot Fiery Death
label: Quest
description: Hot Fiery Death: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The only thing that remains of this human are some charred bones. He seems to have died within arms reach of what he was after - unfired plate gauntlets.
Perhaps you should grab the gauntlets and get out of the fire?
